name: Boon of Fluid Forms

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Once per Long Rest, Magic action transforms you for 1 hour into a Beast, Humanoid, or Monstrosity of CR 10 or less, with Temporary HP equal to its HP. Ends early when these run out or a Magic action restores your form. Retain type, alignment, personality, mental scores, HP, Hit Dice, proficiencies, communication, and Spellcasting/Pact Magic; choose whether equipment drops or adapts. All shape-shifting Temporary HP gains increase by 20.
